data.name: Login_VpnUnsupported
data.value: VPN (OpenVPN) connections are not supported in this version yet. Connect from the WPF app, or sign in to a server that does not need a VPN.

data.name: Tfa_RecoveryLow
data.value: Only a few recovery keys are left. Generate a new set after signing in.

data.name: Tfa_SecurityKeyUnsupported
data.value: Security keys (WebAuthn) are not supported in this app — use TOTP or a recovery key, or an API token.

data.name: Tfa_NoMethod
data.value: No two-factor method usable for this account. Check its two-factor settings in the web UI or use an API token.

data.name: Login_VpnNote
data.value: Opens an OpenVPN tunnel with this .ovpn before signing in (desktop). On Linux and macOS openvpn needs permission to create the tunnel (root or CAP_NET_ADMIN). On Android, connect with a VPN app first.
